backups.info:
Backup Frequency

Unless otherwise secified or requested by the client:

  • All servers and workstations are backed up on the half hour, every hour.
  • We are alerted to any failures if they continue after 24 hours.
    • Backups that fail at say 1:30pm but good at 2:30pm we are not notified on.
    • Failure factors can be things such as an internet outage, network outage, reboot taking place, overlapping jobs because a previous job is still running, or the server needs a reboot because something is stopping the VSS services from executing properly.

Testing Frequency

  • AutoVerify testing on the local BDR appliance is performed nightly for both servers and workstations.
  • Cloud AutoVerify testing runs randomly within a 7-day period for servers and a 14-day period for workstations. While we can't specify the next schedule, it will occur sometime within those 7/14 days on average. Snapshots that have been previously tested and found to be successful will not be retested.
